name: AGC-005 — URL-Shortener Redirect Chain
description: Manual Execution & Real Telemetry (Phase 2) by Ali (TOOSHY2). | AGC-005: URL-shortener redirect chain. Phishing lure (agc005-email.eml) delivered benign-looking shortener link (http://10.10.40.10/go/abc123) executing HTTP 302 Found redirect to credential harvester (/portal-login). Triangulated across terminal hop-by-hop dissection (curl -i), Zeek http.log (GET 302 -> GET 200 -> POST), OPNsense firewall pass (P14-RuleA), and Wazuh SIEM generic detection rule (100006). Verdict: True Positive, Confidence: Critical.
